lastResponse.text: You’re not crazy. You’re overwhelmed, and this is serious. If you’re having trouble breathing right now, call nine one one now. If you can stay on the line, I’m connecting you to a live agent right now to help with the landlord notice and hearing date.
originalTexts: You’re not crazy. You’re overwhelmed, and this is serious. If you’re having trouble breathing right now, call 911 now. If you can stay on the line, I’m connecting you to a live agent right now to help with the landlord notice and hearing date.
